semantics.function: out equals the number of one bits in in
semantics.timing: combinational; output follows current input after combinational settling, with no clock-cycle latency
semantics.initialization: no stored state or initialization required
semantics.handshake: none; all binary input vectors are legal

numeric.arithmetic: exact sum of three unsigned one-bit values, each extended to two bits
numeric.overflow: none; two output bits represent the maximum count of three

verification.coverage: check all eight inputs and all 64 ordered input transitions after settling
verification.checks: explicit-top Icarus SystemVerilog compile with warnings, self-checking simulation using case inequality and finite compile/run timeouts
verification.scope: development verification only; no official reference, synthesis, or board checks

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z inputs is unspecified by the original problem; binary inputs define the required verification domain.
